## Call chains reaching `i915_pm_suspend`

Only two PCI PM callback entries point to `i915_pm_suspend`:

### System suspend

```text
PCI PM core
  -> i915_pm_ops.suspend
  -> i915_pm_suspend(struct device *kdev)
       -> kdev_to_i915(kdev)
       -> i915_drm_suspend(&i915->drm)
            -> to_i915(dev)
            -> dev_priv = drm private data
            -> dev_priv->display
            -> intel_display_driver_suspend(display)
```

Locations:

- `i915_driver.c:1719`: `.suspend = i915_pm_suspend`
- `i915_driver.c:1392`: `i915_pm_suspend()`
- `i915_driver.c:1404`: calls `i915_drm_suspend()`
- `i915_driver.c:1103`: `i915_drm_suspend()`

### Hibernation poweroff

```text
PCI PM core
  -> i915_pm_ops.poweroff
  -> i915_pm_suspend(struct device *kdev)
       -> kdev_to_i915(kdev)
       -> i915_drm_suspend(&i915->drm)
            -> to_i915(dev)
            -> dev_priv = drm private data
            -> dev_priv->display
            -> intel_display_driver_suspend(display)
```

Locations:

- `i915_driver.c:1745`: `.poweroff = i915_pm_suspend`
- The remainder of the chain is identical to system suspend.

Thus, the complete set of PM callback entries that reach `i915_pm_suspend` is:

| PM callback entry | Function path |
|---|---|
| `.suspend` | `i915_pm_suspend()` → `i915_drm_suspend()` |
| `.poweroff` | `i915_pm_suspend()` → `i915_drm_suspend()` |

Other suspend-related callbacks do **not** reach `i915_pm_suspend`:

```text
.freeze
  -> i915_pm_freeze
       -> i915_drm_suspend directly
```

```text

       -> i915_drm_suspend_late
```

```text

  -> i915_pm_poweroff_late
       -> i915_drm_suspend_late(..., true)
```

The switcheroo path also bypasses `i915_pm_suspend`:

```text
i915_switcheroo_set_state
  -> i915_driver_suspend_switcheroo
       -> i915_drm_suspend directly
       -> i915_drm_suspend_late
```

The runtime path is separate:

```text
PCI runtime PM core
```

This is not the same as the system-suspend display path and does not call `i915_drm_suspend()`.
